2124290645091058081.en_summary: In other words it's complete bullshit. There is no digital credit. Strategy just transfers value from common to preferred shareholders. It can only do this until all the common shareholder value is extracted. Then if there is any Bitcoin left after note holders get paid, it goes to preferred stockholders.
2124290645091058081.zh_summary: 換句話說這完全是廢話。沒有數字信用。Strategy 只是將價值從普通股轉移到優先股股東。它只能這樣做直到所有普通股股東價值被提取。然後如果票據持有人獲償後還有比特幣，它歸優先股股東。
